statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-09 on the apache-activemq-6.3.3-bin.tar.gz release the image is built from. CVE-2026-56130 is the Shiro remember-me cookie not being checked for expiry on the server; that cookie handling is shiro-web's CookieRememberMeManager. The release ships three Shiro jars, all under lib/optional: shiro-core-2.2.1, shiro-spring-2.2.1 and activemq-shiro-6.3.3 (tar -tzf); there is no shiro-web jar, so CookieRememberMeManager is not in the image. A byte scan of every class found 0 remember-me references in activemq-shiro (ActiveMQ's own ShiroPlugin, which builds a DefaultSecurityManager whose remember-me manager defaults to null) and only in shiro-spring's Spring configuration classes, which need the absent shiro-web classes and which ActiveMQ never imports; the shipped conf/activemq.xml does not mention Shiro at all. The fix exists only in Shiro 3.0.0, a major line ActiveMQ 6.3 does not use. Revisit if an ActiveMQ release adds shiro-web.
